json.justification: The electric meter in Photos 2 and 14 sits near a gas meter and regulator on the same wall. That wall runs directly beside a gravel/concrete-strip driveway where a car is parked (Photos 9-11, 14), so any install spot would be within 5 ft of both the drive path and the gas equipment. Windows, a chimney column and a window AC unit also interrupt the wall, so the site cannot be confidently approved.
